APPROVE

The helper's early-return condition is the exact negation of the original `i + 1 < glob.Length && glob[i + 1] == '*'` check, and it returns the same index (`i`, `i + 2` or `i + 1`) that the original left in `i`, so behaviour is unchanged. Moving the nested branches out drops several nesting-weighted increments from `ToRegex`, bringing it below 15. The new private static method uses only types already in use, so I see nothing that would add a warning. I haven't run the build or the complexity analyser, so those two conclusions come from reading the diff.
